personal.name: Soumita Bhattacharya Sen

personal.summary: Results-driven Data Analyst with 11+ years of expertise in delivering strategic business insights through advanced proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, Qlik View, Qlik Sense, Alteryx, and Google Looker. My strengths include end-to-end data sourcing and ETL orchestration using SQL Developer, Azure Databricks, and Informatica PowerCenter. Eager to innovate, I am expanding my skill set in Machine Learning, statistical analysis, and data modelling to design and implement cutting-edge, data-driven strategies.
